_about: Country settings for local job search, funding schemes and local demand notes. job_search urls use {q} for the job title. local_demand lists roles (role id @ ladder stage index, 0 = entry) named as critical occupations in an official local source; source says where the claim comes from. Budgets are monthly learning budgets in local currency.

MY.name: Malaysia
funding: If you are employed, ask HR whether a course can be claimed under your employer's HRD Corp levy.
National job portal with career and training programmes for job seekers.
MY.local_demand_source: Named among the 66 roles in TalentCorp's MyMahir Malaysia Critical Occupations List (MyCOL) 2024/2025, as reported by SAYS on 9 January 2026. Check the full list on TalentCorp's MyMahir portal.
MY.trend_note: Malaysian job-ad data has no open API, so demand trends use global job posts. Local demand notes come from TalentCorp's critical occupations list.

SG.name: Singapore
funding: Singapore citizens aged 25 and above can use SkillsFuture Credit for approved courses.
SG.trend_note: Demand trends use global job posts, plus Adzuna Singapore job ads when the server has an Adzuna key.
